title: Disintegrating Night Walkers

sources.title: Night Walker
markers: | summary = '''Night Walker''' is a passive feature that allows the user freedom of movement without any common restrictions.

sources.title: Misty Step
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to teleport themselves to an unoccupied space they can see.

summary: Cannot be Enwebbed, Entangled or Ensnared, and cannot slip on Grease or Ice.

fields.Misty Step: Bonus Action once per Short Rest. Teleport to a visible unoccupied space within 60 ft.
fields.Base value: 360 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
